item.title: Cyber defense tech company RedLattice plans to go public via the Bold Eagle Acquisition Corp. SPAC, in a deal valuing RedLattice at ~$1.25B including debt (Liana Baker/Bloomberg)
AI agent startup Instinct raised a $1B Series C from Sequoia, Benchmark, and Coatue at a $10B valuation and details recent products, such as a concierge service (Utkarsh Shetti/Reuters)

NYC-based Confido, a provider of AI-powered workflow automation tools for consumer packaged goods companies, raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners (AlleyWatch)
item.description: For decades, CPG software recorded the work but never did it, says Confido Cofounder and CEO Justin Hunter. Closing that gap between logging a problem and actually fixing it is what convinced 250+ CPG brands, from Dude Wipes to Unilever, to run their back office through Confido. The company just closed a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners, bringing total funding to $77M, on the back of 5x year-over-year growth. See what happens when finance, sales, and operations finally run on the same system.
